description: Twelve editable starter interests: eight Context concepts plus four related interests. Not expected answers or a hardcoded search ontology.
activation: The local UI or CLI explicitly enables discovery after runner capability and budgets are displayed.

queries.query: Which maintained approaches reduce coding-agent context and tool-output overhead while preserving requirements, raw-output recovery and useful behavior?
Which reusable agent skills and delivery conventions work across coding assistants without large always-loaded instructions?
Which practical patterns and tools improve bounded coding-agent delegation, independent review and handoffs without duplicated work or runaway cost?
Which current evidence and practices help select a coding model and reasoning effort by task difficulty, cost, latency and observed failures?
Which practical evaluations can show that an agent harness, context module or skill improves real development tasks rather than only passing metadata checks?
Which evidence-backed writing practices and selective tools remove vague AI-generated prose while preserving technical meaning and the author's voice?
Which maintained AI-assisted frontend design and UX workflows produce distinctive, accessible, responsive sites with real browser critique?
Which lightweight Git and release practices keep autonomous coding changes coherent, reviewable and reversible without tagging every commit?
Which practical AWS-hosted static-site architectures improve performance, security, deployment simplicity and rollback without unnecessary infrastructure?
Which maintained Terraform and infrastructure-as-code checks catch important configuration, policy and supply-chain problems without burdensome tool stacks?
Which laptop-friendly local-first knowledge and research tools support portable data, search, provenance and useful AI integration without an always-on server?
Which practical tools and patterns help small businesses automate intake, documents and follow-up with clear ownership, privacy and manageable operating cost?

note: Per-query enabled selects participation; discovery is still globally disabled until explicit local enablement. Queries are copied into ignored local settings, not edited in this kit.
